title: Breadboard Rise Reading Weekly Hours Since Mix Trend
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breadboard:rise hours_since_mix=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(hours_since_mix) as avg_duration, max(hours_since_mix) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst hours since mix for Breadboard rise reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture hours_since_mix on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average hours since mix with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly whether Breadboard rise reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
